configuration.description: Choose a preset or define your own fields.

preview.title: Data Preview
preview.emptyDescription: Configure your dataset and click Generate Data.
preview.staleWarning: Configuration changed. Preview and exports still use the last generated data. Generate again to update them.

fieldEditor.choiceHint: Separate options with commas, e.g. Common, Rare, Epic.

validation.duplicateName: Field names must be unique, regardless of uppercase or lowercase.
validation.invalidNumber: Field "{{name}}": Min and Max must be valid integers. Min cannot be greater than Max.
validation.invalidString: Field "{{name}}": String length must be between 1 and 100.
validation.invalidChoice: Field "{{name}}": Enter at least one non-empty option and remove any blank options.
validation.invalidDate: Field "{{name}}": Both dates are required. Start Date cannot be after End Date.
validation.invalidPattern: Field "{{name}}": Invalid pattern. Use tokens like {digits:6}, {letters:4}, or {choice:Red|Blue}. Lengths must be 1–100, and choices need at least 2 options.
